server.description: Make and take phone calls with voice agents, transcribe audio, and turn text into speech from one Speko account. Build and test agents and manage phone numbers.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Speko Docs MCP is the public, read-only discovery surface for Speko's voice-AI API, SDKs, adapters, quickstarts, and migration guides.

Read spekoai://docs/index first, then read the matching spekoai://docs/{slug} resource. Use docs.search when you know the job or field name but not the document slug.

When the user asks how to install or connect Speko in an MCP client, call setup.connect; it shows the endpoint and per-client setup steps.

This endpoint never exposes account data or write tools and requires no authentication. Use the authenticated operational MCP endpoint at https://mcp.speko.ai/mcp for agents, calls, sessions, phone numbers, knowledge bases, evals, and organization state.

tool.name: docs.search
tool.title: Search Speko Docs
tool.description:
Search bundled Speko docs. Returns slug, title, score, snippet.

Use this to look up SDK usage, API request/body shapes, and migration
steps without leaving the MCP session. For example, after a Speko API
validation error, search the failing field name to find the correct
shape. Each hit's `slug` can be opened as the `spekoai://docs/{slug}`
resource; `spekoai://docs/index` lists every bundled doc.

limit.description: How many docs this call returns, best match first. Fewer come back when fewer docs match.

query.description: Free-text query. Matched case-insensitively against the titles and bodies of every bundled Speko doc (hosted llms.txt exports, SDK/adapter READMEs, migration guides, quickstart).

kind.description: Document type: guide (migration guides), llms (hosted docs export), quickstart, or readme (package README).

slug.description: Doc id. Read the full document as the spekoai://docs/{slug} resource.

score.description: Keyword-match relevance; higher is better. Compare scores only within one response.

snippet.description: Text around the first exact match of the query, or the start of the doc when only individual words matched. Use it to judge the hit before reading it.

package_name.description: Package or docs bundle the doc belongs to, e.g. @spekoai/sdk, spekoai (Python) or docs.speko.dev.

result.description: Matching bundled docs, ordered by descending relevance.

tool.name: setup.connect
tool.title: Connect Speko
tool.description:
Show how to connect an MCP client to Speko.

Use this when the user asks how to install, add or connect Speko in an
MCP client such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Cursor. Returns the
hosted endpoint, a guided installer command, how sign-in works, and a
ready-to-paste setup snippet per client. Connecting gives the client the
full Speko toolset: calls, agents, phone numbers and speech.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Speko to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Speko to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.speko.ai/.

_published_faq.name: Is Speko MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Speko scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Speko's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, Speko scores 96/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 2 of 2 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Speko?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Speko in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, turva.dev, AgentMail, Celesto Cloud Computers, and GitCafe.
